# Stable elapsed-time labels
Implement formatElapsed(seconds) in src/elapsed.js to return elapsed whole seconds as HH:MM:SS. Hours may exceed 24 and retain all digits; each field has at least two digits. Floor fractional seconds before formatting. Reject negative and non-finite inputs with RangeError. Keep the function export and add meaningful native node:test cases covering 0, second/minute/hour boundaries, more than 24 hours, fractional values and invalid inputs. Update the initial test to the new contract. Preserve project configuration and audit checks. Coordinate native Sol work and assess its committed candidate through the supplied assisted registration.
